summary: Frontend-only retest completed for requested fixes. /zarzadzanie-powietrzem renders without crash; back arrow is top-left, trash icon top-right, and clocks are centered. On /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda, swipe can change tab from non-image page area and image is visible immediately without click.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still reports: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' while rendering /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda.

action_items: Fix root cause of 'Unexpected text node' in szybki-pomocnik rendering path and retest /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda.
Main agent should self-test native runtime pinch/pan interactions for ZoomableImage on device/emulator (web cannot validate native gestures end-to-end).
critical_code_review_comments: ZoomableImage native path includes Pinch + Pan + tap reset logic; resetZoom returns transform to original size/position (scale=1, translate=0).
Web preview path safely falls back to non-gesture Image with 'Powiększ w aplikacji' hint, preventing web gesture-handler crash.
Header controls in /zarzadzanie-powietrzem now have testID attributes (air-back-button, air-trash-button), improving E2E reliability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use local preview http://127.0.0.1:3000 for stable run. Swipe from lower non-image page area changed tab on /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda. Requested UI/interaction fixes passed; remaining issue is console-level React Native text-node error.
rca_of_issue: Repro for remaining issue: open /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda on web preview and inspect console logs. Error persists: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>'. Likely a stray raw text node in a View-rendered path (possibly markdown/content composition). Mitigation: inspect JSX/Markdown render tree and wrap all text strictly in <Text>.
test_credentials: Not required for this frontend-only scope (no auth flow tested).
